instruction.vi: Chuẩn bị 1 phút rồi nói 1–2 phút; ghi âm và tự nghe lại.

questions.prompt_en: Describe a traditional celebration you enjoy. You should say: what it is; when it happens; what people do; why it matters to you.
questions.prompt_vi: Part 2: chuẩn bị 60 giây, nói tối đa 2 phút.

answer.model_en: A traditional celebration I enjoy is the Mid-Autumn Festival, which usually takes place around September or October. When I was younger, I looked forward to it because children could carry lanterns and spend the evening outside with their families. I remember walking around my neighbourhood with friends while adults prepared snacks and talked together. The colourful lanterns made the streets feel very different from an ordinary evening. These days, I do not celebrate in exactly the same way, but I still enjoy the atmosphere. Families often buy mooncakes, and some communities organise performances or activities for children. I think the festival is important because it gives people an opportunity to share traditions across generations. For example, grandparents can tell stories about how they celebrated when they were young, while children experience the excitement for themselves. One thing I particularly like is that the celebration does not have to be expensive. A simple lantern and an evening with relatives can be enough to create good memories. Of course, modern celebrations sometimes include a lot of advertising, and that can make the event feel more commercial. Even so, I believe its main value is bringing family members and neighbours together for a shared occasion.

questions.explanation_vi: Mẫu chỉ để tham khảo, không bắt buộc học thuộc. Đối chiếu bốn tiêu chí nói.

phases.utterance_vi: Bạn sẽ có một phút chuẩn bị và tối đa hai phút nói. Hãy ghi từ khóa thay vì viết cả câu.
Ghi một ý cho từng gạch đầu dòng, sau đó nghĩ thêm một chi tiết hoặc ví dụ.
Nói tự nhiên; nếu bí ý, dùng một câu chuyển ý rồi nói tiếp.
Kiểm tra đã nói đủ ý, có ví dụ cụ thể và dùng thì phù hợp chưa. Mẫu chỉ để tham khảo, không bắt buộc học thuộc.
